entries.title: Six clashes (충)
entries.content: Opposite animals clash: Rat-Horse, Ox-Goat, Tiger-Monkey, Rabbit-Rooster, Dragon-Dog, Snake-Pig. A clash is read as movement and change: moves, job shifts, breakups or breakthroughs.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Six combinations (육합)
entries.content: Pairs that bond: Rat-Ox, Tiger-Pig, Rabbit-Dog, Dragon-Rooster, Snake-Monkey, Horse-Goat. Read as attraction, teamwork and easy cooperation.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Three harmonies (삼합)
entries.content: Groups of three that form one strong element: Monkey-Rat-Dragon (Water), Pig-Rabbit-Goat (Wood), Tiger-Horse-Dog (Fire), Snake-Rooster-Ox (Metal).
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Six harms (육해)
entries.content: Pairs that quietly drain each other: Rat-Goat, Ox-Horse, Tiger-Snake, Rabbit-Dragon, Monkey-Pig, Rooster-Dog. Read as small frictions and misunderstandings.
entries.source: Sajumuse blog: Six Harms Star; Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Punishments (형)
entries.content: Tiger-Snake-Monkey, Ox-Dog-Goat, and Rat-Rabbit are 'punishment' groups; Dragon, Horse, Rooster and Pig can punish themselves. Read as tension that teaches a lesson.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Stem combinations (천간합)
entries.content: Heavenly stems also pair up: Gap-Gi (Earth), Eul-Gyeong (Metal), Byeong-Sin (Water), Jeong-Im (Wood), Mu-Gye (Fire).
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: How the app uses this
entries.content: Your Today card compares today's animal with your day pillar's animal. A combination day is marked smooth; a clash day is marked 'go slow, double-check plans'.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
